_comment: Every key the apps store in their key-value stores, sorted for migration (SWR-MG-01). Read by the shared core (migration.rs itemKeys; migration_flow.rs) and by scripts/check-migration-keys.ts, which fails when a key literal in any app's source is in none of these lists. A key moves only when it is in 'carried'. 'consent' keys are never moved by key: grants are never carried (ruling, issue #569) and only the withdrawal records inside them travel, through the consent adapter (SWR-MG-04). 'perInstall' keys belong to a device, an install or a warranty registration and never move. 'unsorted' keys are neither moved nor dropped yet (SWR-MG-01). Spellings that differ between platforms are listed as they are written (UC-088).
